x-unwire-open: Merge: published spec (discover:api-docs.json, server /b2b/v2, 1 operation) moved under /b2b/v2, server is the app root /; 88 operations derived from assets/main.js.
Discover: the spec is not served as a file, it is embedded in /api-docs/swagger-ui-init.js (swagger-ui-express) and was extracted as text; /api-docs answers 301 to /api-docs/.

Auth: Bearer JWT from POST /rest/user/login (authentication.token), kept in localStorage.token and cookie token; an HTTP interceptor adds 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' and 'X-User-Email' to every request (assets/main.js:1:454061).
Realtime: a socket.io connection to /socket.io is opened (assets/main.js:1:120125); events are not part of this spec.
External: OAuth login reads https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/userinfo with the access token (assets/main.js:1:45973), other origin, left out.
Navigation left out (4): /profile and /dataerasure (window.location.replace, assets/main.js:1:409301), /ftp/order_{id}.pdf (window.open, assets/main.js:1:276869), Twitter share links.
No source maps served (main.js.map, vendor.js.map answer with HTML): operation names come from the minified Angular service methods.
Skipped scripts: cookieconsent 3.1.0 and jQuery 2.2.4 from cdnjs.cloudflare.com (other origin); /zone.js is an SPA fallback.
Dropped candidates: 2 XHR calls in vendor.js (library internals, URL variable g).

Generic list endpoints (/api/Challenges/, /api/Products/, /api/Feedbacks/, /api/Recycles/, /api/SecurityQuestions/, /rest/user/authentication-details/) take a filter object as query params; the allowed fields are unknown.
Response schemas are only the top-level field the UI reads (data, user, authentication, ...); full models not derived.
